name: responsive-dialog
title: Responsive dialog
description: One dialog API that is a centred modal on desktop and a bottom drawer on phones, switching live without losing the content's state.
docs: Pass title and description (both required, and both wired into either shape), a trigger, the children and an optional footer, then open and onOpenChange to control it or leave them out. It is one element that changes shape, not two components: above breakpoint (640px by default) it is a centred dialog, below it a bottom drawer with a grab handle that closes on a drag past a third of its height or a quick flick; resize or rotate while it is open and nothing in the children is remounted, so typed text and scroll positions stay. Tall children scroll in the body while the title and the footer stay; the footer pads for the home indicator in the drawer (the page needs viewport-fit=cover in its viewport meta for that inset to have a value). Focus lands on a child marked data-autofocus, else on the first field, else on the title, and returns to the trigger on close. dismissible={false} turns off Escape, an outside tap, the close button and the drag, so only your own buttons close it. The viewport is read after mount, so server and browser markup agree.
